_notes: PRINCIPAL MANDATE (2026-07-31): the human principal explicitly chose the maximum-risk stock book, overriding the tournament's capital-preservation DQ of xsec_refined and the failed alpha (DSR) gate — recorded in docs/TOURNAMENT_EQ.md. Expectations set: holdout showed +58%/yr with -39% drawdown on a survivorship-biased backtest; point-in-time literature implies live results roughly half the backtest with drawdowns potentially far worse. kill_drawdown raised to 0.5 deliberately: the strategy's own profile includes ~-40% drawdowns, and a tighter switch would convert a normal momentum drawdown into permanent exit (crypto tournament lesson). CORRECTION (2026-08-09, v0.1.1): the previous text here claimed the per-name absolute-momentum defensive routing capped the holdout at -39% and that removing it was untested. Both halves are wrong. It was tested: abs_filter=false produces bit-identical weight matrices to abs_filter=true (DataFrame.equals() == True), and the filter rejects a name on 0 of 89 dev rebalance dates at every top_n from 3 to 12. It is structurally unreachable — a non-positive-momentum name can only enter the rank band when fewer than band_mult*top_n of ~193 names have positive 8-month momentum (9.3% breadth at top_n=6, against a dev floor of 16.6%). The -39% holdout drawdown therefore happened with NO defensive routing engaged, in a +37% bull whose worst index drop was -19%. At gate_mode=none the kill switch is the only risk control this book has. Logged as IDEA_BACKLOG L.2; the live params are unchanged pending a tournament. enabled flips true after the account is funded and books initialize.
